(Japanese: '''ポケモン4コマ大百科''' ''Pokémon 4Koma Encyclopedia'') is a {{pkmn|manga}} created by [[Takahiro Yamashita]]. Each page of the Pokémon 4Koma Encyclopedia manga contains a {{pkmn|4Koma}} cartoon depicting a Pokémon, comedically demonstrating a special ability or trait of each Pokémon. It also shows the height, weight and elemental type of each Pokémon, along with official artwork by [[Ken Sugimori]] from [[Generation III]].

All the cartoons are presented in [[National Pokédex]] order, beginning with {{p|Bulbasaur}}.
